text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before enrolling at the academy, Ikuno 
Dictus was taught the arts of maintenance 
and self-management by her respected 
mentor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's goal is to keep running 
longer than anyone else, and to rack up 
more victories than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To assist with that challenge, the Trainer 
gives her the management app "IRON WILL."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Managing schedules, physical condition, 
and lap times all in one place with AI 
assistance—this app is sure to be of great 
help to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ikuno Dictus's days of challenge 
had begun!
